title: Denmark Votes to Keep the Krone

historical.summary: In the 28 September 2000 referendum on adopting the euro, 53.2% voted no and 46.8% voted yes; turnout was 87.6%. Denmark retained the krone and its euro opt-out. The Nationalbank reported that the fixed exchange-rate policy continued after the vote.

satire.publicSummary: The electorate has declined the proposed currency migration. The krone remains in production; please do not reopen this decision without another referendum.
satire.commitMessage: fix(currency): preserve current unit after migration proposal is declined
satire.diagnosticMessage: Euro adoption was rejected by referendum; the krone and fixed exchange-rate policy continue under Denmark's opt-out.

relations.label: An earlier referendum on European integration

da-DK.title: Danmark stemmer for at beholde kronen
da-DK.historicalSummary: Ved folkeafstemningen den 28. september 2000 om indførelse af euroen stemte 53,2 procent nej og 46,8 procent ja; valgdeltagelsen var 87,6 procent. Danmark beholdt kronen og sit euroforbehold. Nationalbanken oplyste, at fastkurspolitikken fortsatte efter afstemningen.
da-DK.publicSummary: Vælgerne har afvist den foreslåede valutaovergang. Kronen forbliver i drift; genåbn venligst ikke beslutningen uden en ny folkeafstemning.
da-DK.commitMessage: fix(currency): behold den nuværende valuta efter at forslaget om ændring blev afvist
da-DK.diagnosticMessage: Vælgerne afviste indførelsen af euroen; kronen og fastkurspolitikken fortsætter under Danmarks forbehold.

relationLabels.DK-1972-001: En tidligere folkeafstemning om europæisk integration
